groups.rationale: Antithesis access workload only: the magic-preview pending-MFA oracle now follows accepted ADR-0160 (ordinary /overview read on replica B served without verification or new login; SecurityLive passkey rename refused with unchanged passkey inventory) instead of the superseded ADR-0123/ADR-0131 read-boundary redirect; 17-reference scanner count moves 163 to 164 SDK callsites with 30 primaries unchanged. No Marshall code, protocol, deployment or security-boundary change.

HLDD chapter 08 now states the upgraded editor/web WebSocket lifetime (lease, peer close or 60 s browser idle, not the listener 5 s HTTP read timeout) for the Audi relay idle-timeout fix, with its regression test linked.

Only the shared 17-reference chapter changed: the Antithesis literal scanner count moves 163 to 164 after the magic-preview pending-MFA oracle was aligned to ADR-0160. No protocol source, contract or wire behavior changed.

Records 77f494c9's signed Overalls Cachix substitution and watch-store publishing, whose 12-configuration and 19-coverage sections match the shared cache module, guest and Ubuntu nix.conf and fleet agent; also brings stale evaluation tests in line with ADR-0075's removed personal firewall sources and ADR-0182's lilly-owned /run/lilly-brady, and gives CI runners the kvm feature for evaluation-time image builds.

Audi's WebSocket relay now passes an explicit 60 s idle timeout at upgrade, so Thousand Island no longer applies the listener's 5 s HTTP read_timeout and Bandit no longer closes a quiet editor or web socket with 1002; chapter 08 states the upgraded-socket lifetime and links the regression test.
The explicit Hegel framework check and remaining-driver classification add verification derivations only; no production deployment roles, hosts, services, Nix options or runtime topology changed.

Only the shared 17-reference chapter changed: the Antithesis literal scanner count moves 163 to 164 after the magic-preview pending-MFA oracle was aligned to ADR-0160 (ordinary read served, passkey rename refused). No docs, scripts, ADR or governance source changed; ADR-0160 status is unchanged.
